basic_details.job_title: Shillong Medical College Radiotherapy Technician Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 8 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Government of Meghalaya, Office of the Director of Health Services (MI), Meghalaya, Shillong (DHS Meghalaya) has invited applications for 8 posts of Radiotherapy Technician under Advt No. HSM/EST/GZT/Appt/DAE/61/2026/41871. The online application is open from 7 November 2026 to 14 November 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Paid after submitting the application online.

qualification.education_qualification: B.Sc. in Radiotherapy Technology with a minimum of 50% marks from a recognized institution; OR Higher Secondary (10+2) Science from a recognized Board/Institution with Diploma in Radiotherapy Technology from a recognized institution.
qualification.details: Qualification: B.Sc. in Radiotherapy Technology with a minimum of 50% marks from a recognized institution; OR Higher Secondary (10+2) Science from a recognized Board/Institution with Diploma in Radiotherapy Technology from a recognized institution Age limit: Maximum 32 years Age relaxation: ST/SC 5 years (as per O.M No. PER.38/2021/30 Dated 3/2/2022) | Other conditions: | Open to bonafide citizens of India Preference will be given to candidates who are domicile of the State of Meghalaya

how_to_apply: Apply online at www.meghealth.gov.in between 7 November 2026 (5 PM) and 14 November 2026 (12 MN).
Register, apply and upload the necessary information and documents.
Pay the application fee after submitting the application.
Applications received through any other mode will be summarily rejected.
important_instructions: Result will be made available on the website and in local newspaper Name on the list of successful candidates does not necessarily qualify for appointment Queries may be mailed to [email protected] during office hours

B.Sc. in Radiotherapy Technology with a minimum of 50% marks from a recognized institution; OR Higher Secondary (10+2) Science from a recognized Board/Institution with Diploma in Radiotherapy Technology from a recognized institution.

content_sections.heading: Shillong Medical College Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. HSM/EST/GZT/Appt/DAE/61/2026/41871 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download DHS Meghalaya notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: B.Sc. in Radiotherapy Technology with a minimum of 50% marks from a recognized institution; OR Higher Secondary (10+2) Science from a recognized Board/Institution with Diploma in Radiotherapy Technology from a recognized institution Age limit: Maximum 32 years Age relaxation: ST/SC 5 years (as per O.M No. PER.38/2021/30 Dated 3/2/2022) Other conditions: Open to bonafide citizens of India Preference will be given to candidates who are domicile of the State of Meghalaya

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for Shillong Medical College Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates giving incorrect information or false declaration about eligibility are liable to be debarred from examinations of the Directorate

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Contractual posts Selected candidates must adhere to the ToR laid down by the Office of the Director of Health Services (MI)

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: Paid after submitting the application online.

rows.event: Opening date for the application form (at 5 PM)
Closing date for the application form (12 MN)

content_sections.heading: How Will Shillong Medical College Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Pre-screening of applications by competent authority Shortlisting of candidates whose documents are in order Walk-in Interview Verification of original documents Selection purely on merit of the interview 24 candidates (3 times the posts) will be called for the walk-in interview Shortlist will be displayed on www.meghealth.gov.in Final selection subject to satisfactory verification of original documents

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Updated Curriculum Vitae (CV) Educational qualification certificates, including B.Sc. or Diploma in Radiotherapy Technology Experience certificate(s), if available ST/SC certificate from the Competent Authority, if applicable Proof of date of birth: Birth Certificate or SSLC/Matriculation Admit Card/Certificate Mark sheets of all relevant examinations; proof of identity (Epic/Aadhar/Pan card/Driving Licence)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Shillong Medical College Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Apply online at www.meghealth.gov.in between 7 November 2026 (5 PM) and 14 November 2026 (12 MN). Register, apply and upload the necessary information and documents. Submit the application online. Pay the application fee after submitting the application. Applications received through any other mode will be summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Result will be made available on the website and in local newspaper Name on the list of successful candidates does not necessarily qualify for appointment Queries may be mailed to [email protected] during office hours

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DHS Meghalaya Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 14 November 2026. Applications opened on 7 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DHS Meghalaya Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 8 vacancies for Radiotherapy Technician.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DHS Meghalaya Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 14 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: General: Rs. 500. ST/SC: Rs. 250.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 32 years. Relaxation: ST/SC 5 years (as per O.M No. PER.38/2021/30 Dated 3/2/2022).

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 25,000 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: B.Sc. in Radiotherapy Technology with a minimum of 50% marks from a recognized institution; OR Higher Secondary (10+2) Science from a recognized Board/Institution with Diploma in Radiotherapy Technology from a recognized institution.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Open to bonafide citizens of India. Preference will be given to candidates who are domicile of the State of Meghalaya.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates giving incorrect information or false declaration about eligibility are liable to be debarred from examinations of the Directorate.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Pre-screening of applications by competent authority. Shortlisting of candidates whose documents are in order. Walk-in Interview. Verification of original documents.
